description: Build the transaction for a quoteId and dry-run it on-chain (EVM eth_call + gas estimate from the sender; Solana simulateTransaction) without sending anything or recording an order. Reports whether it would succeed, gas / compute units, whether an ERC-20 approval is still needed, and the error if it would fail. Read-only: The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions.

quoteId.description: quoteId from get_quote (starts with "q_"). Quotes expire after a short time (see expiresAt).

name: simulate_transaction
title: Dry-run a quote's transaction
